questions: Do you have a known diagnosis of epilepsy?
Were you previously taking the medication zonisamide for this condition?
Did you stop taking your zonisamide recently before these symptoms started?
Are you currently experiencing involuntary jerking movements in your arms or hands?
Have you had any recent episodes of loss of consciousness or convulsions (seizures)?
results: 1. cognitive screen (MMSE / MoCA / FAB): MMSE 23/30 and Frontal Assessment Battery 9/18 - frontal/executive dysfunction
2. copper / caeruloplasmin / 24 h urinary copper: normal - excludes Wilson disease
3. genetic testing (targeted panel or exome): NOTCH2NLC GGC repeat expansion - genetically confirmed NIID
4. skin biopsy: eosinophilic, p62- and ubiquitin-POSITIVE intranuclear inclusions in adipocytes, sweat gland cells and fibroblasts - diagnostic of NIID
dx_raw: DIAGNOSIS: Neuronal intranuclear inclusion disease (NIID) caused by a GGC repeat expansion in the NOTCH2NLC gene
dx: Neuronal intranuclear inclusion disease (NIID) caused by a GGC repeat expansion in the NOTCH2NLC gene
